additional_info.subject: Case Update
additional_info.body: The CCV payment terminal was replaced, but it still needs to be activated. EDP will still need to go and activate it.

additional_info.subject: EPD went on site but could not fix the settings as the terminal was wrong (see pictures)
additional_info.body:
Please see pictures below. The difference is in the “Key”. The one with “Cardprocess” is the wrong one. The other one with “CCV-KNB” is the only correct one
Also, we should get the right software to adjust the CCV settings ourselves. Marnic has provided the following info:
"
Dag Erik, de commissioning software van ccv is "terminalsupervisor 3" te verkrijgen bij ccv zelf, bij de supportlijn inclusief de licentie (lvl4). De hotline die wij gebruikte is hotline@de.ccv.eu.
Indien gewenst kunnen wij in Brussel op onze lader ook een korte opleiding geven over de commissiong van deze terminal."
